A '''mutated Geonosian''' [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] was the progenitor of the [[mutated Geonosian]]s, developed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Malora]] around the time of the [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] between [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
